title: Dialogue Overhaul
description: Keeps the normal camera during conversations and lets you move while talking.

Camera.label: Keep the normal camera
Camera.hint: No dialogue close-up or FOV change when a conversation starts. The game's own Settings > Dialogue Camera option also turns the close-up off.

Controls.label: Move while talking
Controls.hint: Walk, run, sprint, jump and crouch during conversations. Walking too far away may end the conversation. Takes effect at the next conversation.

Controls.label: Look around while talking
Controls.hint: Turn the camera with the mouse during conversations. Takes effect at the next conversation.
